description: Splits a clip into Drums/Bass/Other/Vocals tracks with the Demucs (htdemucs) source separator, aligned with the source clip. Slow: minutes for a full song, CPU only; reports progress in 5% steps when the call carries a progressToken. Needs the model weights, which the Audionaut app downloads once (Settings > Separation); fails with model_missing until then, and with demucs_unavailable in builds without Demucs.

clip.description: Playlist item id (default: the track's first clip)

mute_source.description: Mute the source track's channels (default true)

project.description: Path to the .audium project package (absolute paths recommended)

task.description: Name of the task this edit is part of, e.g. "remove speech pauses". In the open app, all edits with the same task name become one undo step: keep the name for every call of the task and change it when the next task starts. Without a task name, all edits of this session share one step

track.description: Track id (default 0; imported audio lands on a new track)

name: separate_stems
title: Separate stems
